title: Mnesis C2 recording manifest (C2b, schema_version c2/1.0)
description: Inventory-only manifest a capture surface (Iris phone, Eidolon headset, robot recorder) writes next to one recording and uploads as the `manifest` part of the C2 episode upload. It records what was ACTUALLY captured — the capture options that took effect, a per-stream confirmation, the tracker runtime that really ran, every media file with its sha256, and one shared timebase — so the ingest side (Ambrosia) can verify the upload without trusting the request. It carries no frame data; frames live in the C1 JSONL. Authority: CONTRACTS.md C2b. Consumers in other languages vendor this file verbatim and pin it by sha256 (see contracts/contracts.lock). Keep in lock-step with mnesis_canonical/recording_manifest.py. Breaking changes bump schema_version.

schema_version.description: Contract version tag. Exactly "c2/1.0" for this schema; a breaking change ships as a new value (e.g. "c2/2.0") together with a new schema file hash.

device.description: The capture device that produced this recording.

id.description: Stable, non-personal device identifier chosen by the capture app (e.g. an install-scoped UUID). Must not be a hardware serial or phone number.

app_version.description: Version string of the capture app that wrote this manifest (e.g. "0.4.2+build.118").

os.description: Operating system name and version of the device as reported at record time (e.g. "Android 15").

timebase.description: The single clock every timestamp in this recording is expressed against: a monotonic clock origin plus the wall-clock instant it corresponds to.

monotonic_start_ns.description: Reading of the device monotonic clock at recording start, in integer nanoseconds. Frame `t_ns` values in the C1 JSONL are on this same clock.

utc_start.description: Wall-clock time at recording start, RFC 3339 with an explicit offset (`Z` or `+hh:mm`), e.g. "2026-09-28T08:15:30.125Z".

clock_source.description: Name of the monotonic clock `monotonic_start_ns` was read from (e.g. "android_elapsed_realtime_nanos", "xr_runtime_monotonic", "posix_clock_monotonic").

resolved_capture_options.description: Capture parameters that actually took effect after the device negotiated/clamped the requested ones (not what was requested). Free-form: surfaces may add their own keys, but `video` and `streams` are always present.

video.description: Effective primary video encoder settings. Extra keys (e.g. bitrate_bps, keyframe_interval_s) are allowed.

codec.description: Codec actually used by the encoder, lowercase short name (e.g. "h264", "hevc", "av1").

fps.description: Effective encode frame rate in frames per second.

streams.description: Names of every stream the capture session was configured to record (e.g. "rgb", "depth", "head_pose", "hands", "audio"). Each name appears in `stream_confirmations`.

stream_confirmations.description: Per-stream confirmation of what was really recorded, one entry per name in `resolved_capture_options.streams`.

name.description: Stream name, matching an entry of `resolved_capture_options.streams`.

enabled.description: Whether the stream was actually running for this recording. A configured stream the device could not start is reported with `enabled: false` and `frame_count: 0`, never omitted.

width.description: Effective width in pixels for image-like streams; null for non-image streams (poses, audio, IMU).

height.description: Effective height in pixels for image-like streams; null for non-image streams.

fps.description: Effective sample rate in Hz (frames per second for image streams, samples per second for pose/IMU/audio streams). 0 only when `enabled` is false.

frame_count.description: Number of frames/samples actually written for this stream.

dropped_frames.description: Number of frames/samples the pipeline knowingly dropped for this stream (0 when none).

tracker_runtime.description: The pose/hand tracking runtime that actually ran during the recording (as opposed to the one the app was built against).

name.description: Runtime identifier as reported by the device (e.g. "platform_ar_session", "xr_runtime"). Use "none" when no tracker ran.

version.description: Runtime version string as reported at record time.

media.description: Every media file that belongs to this recording, each pinned by sha256 so the receiver can verify the upload byte-for-byte.

path.description: File path relative to the manifest's directory, forward slashes only; no leading slash, no drive letter, no `..` segment.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes (exactly 64 characters).

duration_s.description: Duration of the content in seconds (media time span for video/audio/depth/frames, first-to-last record span for jsonl).

kind.description: Media kind: `video` (self-contained encoded video), `frames_zip` (C2a frames archive), `jsonl` (C1 frame JSONL or side channel), `audio`, `depth`.
